review_question: Does the011 negative diagnostic close any remaining lifetime gap at the exact009 final-release failure?
answer: No first invalidator captured; no BO repair or added probe justified by this run.
source_basis: Existing wrapper checks recognized identity before the real nouveau_bo_ref call; the driver executes outside the ledger mutex.
nouveau_bo_del loads bo->device and unmaps before calling free; the allocator hook is after that failing-use boundary.
A write/race after the precheck and before the driver field load is not excluded by sampled equality.
A stale owner after address reuse can see a new valid generation at the same pointer; identity alone does not distinguish it.
Observer locking/timing can perturb the race; internal submission increments are sampled, not individually journaled.
action: Keep bounded observer available but off without marker. Preserve BO fault separately; do not add generalized write watching or repeat identical tests without a discriminator.
